headline: Marban Hollow Re-Ignites as Northern Frontline Clashes Intensify
war_summary: Fighting across the northern battlefront has intensified once again as Marban Hollow flared back into action, logging six base ownership transitions in the past two hours around Checkpoint Bua. Weathered Expanse and Nevish Line continue to bear the heaviest operational strain, recording nine and eight tactical base shifts respectively within the same two-hour span amid substantial infantry attrition. Linn of Mercy witnessed renewed base exchanges at Lathair and Outwich Ranch alongside accelerating casualty rates that topped four hundred combined losses in the latest hour. In Kuura Strand, base contestation persisted with two additional changes logged at Faden Point despite tempered casualties. Meanwhile, Godcrofts registered sudden action as the strategic base at Argosa fell into neutral status. Heavy slugging matches endured without direct base shifts in Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle, where combined casualties surpassed eight hundred and four hundred over two hours, while Stlican Shelf and the southern interior remained comparatively quiet.
